fields.summary_ko.0: Alphabet opened Google Cloud TPU 8tx chips for customer installation in their own data centers, with approximately 100 customers already in use.
fields.summary_ko.1: Google Cloud Q3 revenue exceeded year-ago period by over 100%, reaching $3.07 billion; cloud backlog increased to $56.1 billion from $46.2 billion in the prior quarter; GOOGL currently trading at $292, down 28% from May high of $402.62.
